english_text: Headache is a common side effect and usually resolves on its own.
sesotho_text: Mahloko a hlooho ke tlhamorao e tloaelehileng mme hangata a fela ka boeona.

english_text: Seek emergency help immediately if you develop difficulty breathing.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea tšohanyetso hang hang haeba u ba le bothata ba ho hema.

english_text: This medicine may cause increased sensitivity to sunlight; use sunscreen outdoors.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho amehela haholo leseding la letsatsi; sebelisa sunscreen kantle.

english_text: Diarrhoea is a common side effect; drink plenty of fluids to stay hydrated.
sesotho_text: Sehudo ke tlhamorao e tloaelehileng; noa metsi a mangata ho lula u nang le metsi a lekaneng.

english_text: Stop taking this medicine if you develop yellowing of the skin or eyes.
sesotho_text: Emisa ho nka moriana ona haeba u ba le ho pheela ha letlalo kapa mahlo.

english_text: This medicine may cause a dry cough; inform your doctor if it becomes bothersome.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho kohoa ho omileng; tsebisa ngaka ea hau haeba e ba bothata.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you develop swelling of the face, lips, or throat.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea ngaka haeba u ba le ho ruruha ha sefahleho, menoana ea molomo, kapa molala.

english_text: This medicine may cause constipation; increase your fluid and fibre intake.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho tšoaroa ha mala; eketsa ho noa metsi le fibre.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you notice unusual bruising or bleeding.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u hona ho phahama ha mali kapa ho tsoa mali ho sa tloaelehang.

english_text: This medicine may cause insomnia; take it in the morning to reduce sleep disturbance.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho hloka boroko; o nke hoseng ho fokotsa ho khathatsa ha boroko.

english_text: Seek medical help if you develop severe stomach pain while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea ngaka haeba u ba le mahloko a matla a mpa ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause a metallic taste in the mouth.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka tatso ea tšepe molomong.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you experience muscle pain or weakness.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ikutloa u na le mahloko a mochine kapa ho fokotsehela.

english_text: This medicine may cause increased urination; this is expected and not harmful.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho morota hangata; sena se nahanoa mme ha se kotsi.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you develop a fever while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea ngaka haeba u ba le feberu ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause weight gain; monitor your weight regularly.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho eketseha ha boima; hlahloja boima ba hau ka mehla.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you notice changes in your vision while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u hona liphetoho tsa pono ea hau ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause hair loss; this is usually temporary.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho lahleheloa ke moriri; sena hangata ke sa nakoana.

english_text: Seek medical help if you develop signs of an allergic reaction.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea ngaka haeba u ba le lišoaetso tsa karabelo ea ho amehela.

english_text: This medicine may cause mood changes; inform your doctor if you feel depressed.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka liphetoho tsa maikutlo; tsebisa ngaka ea hau haeba u ikutloa u nyametse.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you experience numbness or tingling in your hands or feet.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ikutloa ho fofa kapa ho hlohlona matsoho kapa maoto.

english_text: This medicine may cause a skin rash; stop taking it and consult your doctor.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho ruruha ha letlalo; emisa ho o nka mme u buisane le ngaka ea hau.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you develop swollen ankles or feet.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea ngaka haeba u ba le li-ankle kapa maoto a ruruhetse.

english_text: This medicine may cause loss of appetite; try eating small, frequent meals.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho lahleheloa ke takatso ea lijo; leka ho ja lijo tse nyenyane, hangata.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you develop a persistent cough while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ba le ho kohoa ho tsoelang pele ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause stomach upset; take it with food to reduce discomfort.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho nyakeloa ha mala; o nke le lijo ho fokotsa ho se ikutloa hantle.

english_text: Seek medical help if you develop confusion or memory problems.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea ngaka haeba u ba le tsieleho kapa mathata a ho hopola.

english_text: This medicine may cause increased sweating; this is usually not harmful.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho tsoa molapo hangata; sena hangata ha se kotsi.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you experience heart palpitations while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ikutloa pelo e otla ka matla ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause a decrease in blood pressure; monitor regularly.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho theohela ha khatello ea mali; hlahloja ka mehla.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you develop signs of liver problems such as dark urine.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea ngaka haeba u ba le lišoaetso tsa mathata a sebete joalo ka moroto o mootho.

english_text: This medicine may cause dry mouth; sip water frequently and chew sugar-free gum.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho oma ha molomo; noa metsi hangata mme u hlafune gum e se nang tsoekere.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you develop joint pain while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ba le mahloko a maqhoa ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause fatigue; rest as needed and avoid strenuous activity.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho lapala; khutsa ha ho hlokeha mme u hane mesebetsi e matla.

english_text: Seek medical help if you develop a severe headache that does not go away.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea ngaka haeba u ba le mahloko a matla a hlooho a sa felong.

english_text: This medicine may cause increased blood sugar; monitor your glucose levels.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho eketseha ha tsoekere ea mali; hlahloja maemo a glucose ea hau.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you notice changes in your heart rate.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u hona liphetoho tsa lebelo la pelo ea hau.

english_text: This medicine may cause skin discolouration; this is usually harmless.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho fetola mebala ea letlalo; sena hangata ha se kotsi.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you develop difficulty swallowing while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea ngaka haeba u ba le bothata ba ho metsa ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause back pain; inform your doctor if it is severe.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka mahloko a mokokotlo; tsebisa ngaka ea hau haeba a matla.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you develop signs of infection such as fever or chills.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ba le lišoaetso tsa tšoaetso joalo ka feberu kapa ho thothomela.

english_text: This medicine may cause a decrease in white blood cells; report any signs of infection.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho fokotseha ha lisele tsa mali tse tšoeu; bua lišoaetso life kapa life tsa tšoaetso.

english_text: Seek medical help if you develop a rash with blistering or peeling skin.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea ngaka haeba u ba le ho ruruha ha letlalo le nang le li-blister kapa ho hlokola ha letlalo.

english_text: This medicine may cause increased sensitivity to cold temperatures.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho amehela haholo mochesong o bata.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you experience shortness of breath while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ikutloa u hloka moya ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause ringing in the ears; inform your doctor if it persists.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho lira ha tsebe; tsebisa ngaka ea hau haeba ho tsoela pele.

english_text: Seek medical attention if you develop signs of kidney problems such as reduced urine output.
sesotho_text: Batla tlhokomelo ea ngaka haeba u ba le lišoaetso tsa mathata a lipitso joalo ka ho fokotseha ha moroto.

english_text: This medicine may cause a burning sensation at the injection site.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka maikutlo a ho chesa sebakeng sa ente.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you develop swelling or redness at the injection site.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ba le ho ruruha kapa ho bofubedu sebakeng sa ente.

english_text: This medicine may cause changes in your menstrual cycle; inform your doctor.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka liphetoho ts'ebetsong ea hau ea khoeli; tsebisa ngaka ea hau.

english_text: Seek medical help if you develop severe muscle cramps while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Batla thuso ea ngaka haeba u ba le ho tšoaroa ha mochine ho matla ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause increased thirst; drink adequate fluids throughout the day.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho nyoroa hangata; noa metsi a lekaneng letsatsing lohle.

english_text: Contact your doctor if you develop a sore throat while taking this medicine.
sesotho_text: Ikopanye le ngaka ea hau haeba u ba le molala o bohloko ha u nka moriana ona.

english_text: This medicine may cause stomach cramps; inform your doctor if they are severe.
sesotho_text: Moriana ona o ka baka ho tšoaroa ha mala; tsebisa ngaka ea hau haeba ho matla.
